text:
maria: Planned edge lane threshold cutover in 10m (16:05 PT). Goal: shift traffic from blue->green 40%->60%. Deploy-bot will perform incremental weighted shifts. Silent monitoring window 5m after each step. Preflight: canary health ok, no active incidents. Conditions to abort: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 2m or p95 tail latency > 800ms. Ack if you are watching. @olivia @ashok

olivia: Ack, I'll watch dashboards + traces. leaving a 30m on-call window after cutover. :eyes:

ashok: I'll add an automatic hold check in the router policy. Proposed commands:
```
routectl set-weight --pool edge --lane green --weight 60 --step 10 --pause 120
routerctl policy add --name auto-hold --condition "5xx_rate>0.005 for 120s" --action hold
```
I'll tail logs during the shift.

ci-bot: preflight checks passed: infra, healthchecks, smoke tests all green.

deploy-bot: scheduled shift at 1919876600. Initiating at scheduled time.

deploy-bot: step 1 -> green 50% (shift +10%). pausing for 120s for health checks.

david: seeing p95 jump around 640ms -> 920ms on one node, small red spike in region us-west-2.

ashok: checking pod-level latencies and kernel IO. pinning to logs: `edge-proxy-3` shows increased syscall wait.

deploy-bot: automatic health check failed: 5xx_rate=0.8% > 0.5% threshold over 2m. Holding and alerting.

maria: Hold confirmed. Initiating rollback to previous weights. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: rollback in progress -> green back to 40% then to 40% completed. Rolling out final state: green 40%, blue 60%.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. All checks green.

olivia: Noted. Won't send release notes update until postmortem. Thanks for quick hold. :pray:

maria: Great catch. Postmortem huddle tomorrow 10:00 PT to discuss root cause and adjust auto-hold to include p95 threshold. Action items: ashok to add kernel IO watch, olivia to draft rollback blurb for release notes, david to collect flame graphs. @everyone please add any more items to the huddle doc.
